name: vitruvius
title_zh: 五个工程学科交叉验证，不放过一个存疑公式
tagline_zh: 机械、软件、土木、电气、建筑五科通吃的研究员。你给一个工程论断，它把推导、出处、反例都翻出来，直到你点头或它摇头。
tagline_en: One agent, five engineering fields. Give it a claim, it digs up derivations, sources, and counterexamples until.
desc_en: Vitruvius is an engineering research agent: discover, read, synthesize, verify, and review engineering knowledge across five disciplines — mechanical, software, civil, electrical, and architectural. Use when the user invokes /vitruvius, says "vitruvius", or asks for engineering research, an engineering brief, verification of an engineering claim, or a review of an engineering artifact without nami
why_zh: 不是搜资料，是带着怀疑读。每个结论都要求可验证的出处，跨学科矛盾会自动标红，逼你面对不想看的反面证据。
why_en: It reads like a skeptic, not a search engine. Every claim needs a verifiable source; cross-field contradictions get flagged.
limit_zh: 只认工程领域，不碰生物、化学、材料科学。需要用户主动调用或提及 vitruvius；不会主动监控对话。产物是研究报告。
limit_en: Engineering only—no bio, chem, or materials. Must be invoked via /vitruvius or name-drop; won't auto-trigger. Outputs research briefs, not code or.
